description: Defines the SimpleEntryImpl class, which manages entries in a simple disk cache, including operations like open, create, doom, and data read/write, with internal state management and asynchronous operation handling.

classes.name: SimpleEntryImpl
classes.description: Manages a cache entry in the simple disk cache, providing methods for opening, creating, dooming, reading, writing, and managing entry state asynchronously.

classes.name: SimpleEntryImpl::ActiveEntryProxy
classes.description: Interface for proxying active entries, allowing entries to make themselves inactive.

methods.name: SimpleEntryImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing a cache entry with specified parameters.

methods.name: SetActiveEntryProxy
methods.description: Sets the active proxy for the entry.

methods.name: OpenEntry
methods.description: Adds a reader/writer to the entry if possible.

methods.name: CreateEntry
methods.description: Creates the cache entry if possible.

methods.name: OpenOrCreateEntry
methods.description: Opens an existing entry or creates a new one.

methods.name: DoomEntry
methods.description: Dooms (deletes) the cache entry.

methods.name: SetKey
methods.description: Sets the key for the cache entry.

methods.name: SetCreatePendingDoom
methods.description: Prepares the entry for optimistic creation with pending doom.

methods.name: NotifyDoomBeforeCreateComplete
methods.description: Notifies that doom should occur before create completes.

methods.name: Doom
methods.description: Dooms the entry.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the entry.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Returns the key of the entry.

methods.name: GetLastUsed
methods.description: Returns the last used time.

methods.name: GetLastModified
methods.description: Returns the last modified time.

methods.name: GetDataSize
methods.description: Returns size of data at a given index.

methods.name: ReadData
methods.description: Reads data from the entry.

methods.name: WriteData
methods.description: Writes data to the entry.

methods.name: ReadSparseData
methods.description: Reads sparse data from the entry.

methods.name: WriteSparseData
methods.description: Writes sparse data to the entry.

methods.name: GetAvailableRange
methods.description: Gets available data range.

methods.name: CouldBeSparse
methods.description: Checks if the entry could be sparse.

methods.name: CancelSparseIO
methods.description: Cancels sparse I/O operations.

methods.name: ReadyForSparseIO
methods.description: Prepares the entry for sparse I/O.

methods.name: SetLastUsedTimeForTest
methods.description: Sets last used time for testing.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Changes the entry's priority.
